replaced.text: Memottoは、文章も表も画像も、ひとつにまとめられるノートアプリです。

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting started with Memotto"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memotto is a note-taking app that lets you combine text, tables, and images in one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide uses examples featuring Yamanashi from PR and Takanashi from sales."}]}

replaced.text: 月見里さんは、大事な箇所にStickyを貼って目印にしています。

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "A short note attached to a page is called a \"Quick Note\"."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi records the decisions from meetings in Quick Notes."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi puts a Sticky on important parts to mark them."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You can add up to ten notes per page."}]}

replaced.text: 小鳥遊さんの営業チームは、まずSpaceを作りました。
Spaceの中で全員が見られる場所を『ひろば』(Commons)と呼びます。

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Using it as a team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi-san's sales team first created a Space."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The area inside a Space that everyone can see is called the \"Commons\" (ひろば)."}]}

replaced.text: Spaceには、メールでメンバーを招待できます。

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post notes in the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi-san shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to a Space by email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Invited people will receive a confirmation email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once an admin approves, they can join right away."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed for each plaza."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and Revisions"}]}

replaced.text: ページのRevisionsから、以前の状態に戻せます。

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all your devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit even when offline, and they sync as soon as you reconnect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can restore a previous state from the page's Revisions."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Mr. Yamanashi recovered a passage he had accidentally deleted."}]}

translations.10: The area inside a Space that everyone can see is called the "Commons" (ひろば).
translations.11: Anyone can post notes in the Commons.
translations.12: Takanashi-san shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning.
translations.13: You can invite members to a Space by email.
translations.14: Invited people will receive a confirmation email.
translations.15: Once an admin approves, they can join right away.
translations.16: Member permissions can also be changed for each plaza.
translations.18: Notes are saved automatically and synced to all your devices.
translations.19: You can edit even when offline, and they sync as soon as you reconnect.
translations.2: Memotto is a note-taking app that lets you combine text, tables, and images in one place.
translations.20: You can restore a previous state from the page's Revisions.
translations.21: Mr. Yamanashi recovered a passage he had accidentally deleted.
translations.24: Pinned pages appear at the top of the list.
translations.25: Notes in Hiroba become easier to find if you add tags.
translations.28: You can use the same tag for a single note as well.
translations.29: In search, you can look for both hiroba and hitokoto at the same time.
translations.3: This guide uses examples featuring Yamanashi from PR and Takanashi from sales.
translations.30: If you can't find something, try widening the search range.
translations.4: A short note attached to a page is called a "Quick Note".
translations.5: Ms. Yamanashi records the decisions from meetings in Quick Notes.
translations.6: Ms. Yamanashi puts a Sticky on important parts to mark them.
translations.7: You can add up to ten notes per page.
translations.9: Takanashi-san's sales team first created a Space.
